label: About
title: About Contour After Midnight
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1212 recent saved-signal files and 358 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @canekzapata: gm and @Dexerto: Famed "Chicago Tape Guy," who recorded over 10,000 live concerts, is uploading them..., plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Contour After Midnight: A nocturnal abstract relief in a poster crop, rendered as a frontal digital scan across a wide horizontal plate. One pale, irregular central peak rises from near-black void, its steep sides finely striated; smaller ridges sit in separated lateral bands. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central pale peak and descending contour, interrupted lavender-white lower ridge, and stepped left-side cut.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
